name: Team Standup
description: Sohbetten ve e-postadan standup görevi, /standup kartı, etkinliğe standup notu, toplantı paneli ve asistan için standup araçları

tools.name: standup_summary
tools.title: Standup özeti
tools.description: Summarises the standup state of the person's projects: for each project the number of open tasks, overdue tasks and tasks completed today, plus the first open tasks with due date and assignee. Give projectId to summarise one project; without it every project the person can see is summarised. Read-only.

projectId.description: Olan project id; omit for all visible projects.

tools.name: standup_add_task
tools.title: Standup görevi ekle
tools.description: Adds one task to an Olan project for the standup, in the project's first work package. Give projectId and the task title; description is optional. It creates a record, so the person confirms it first.
